words.sentence1: Finding my old childhood friend at the airport was pure serendipity (Finding my old childhood friend at the airport was pure chance and luck).
words.sentence2: Science is often driven by happy moments of serendipity (Science is often driven by fortunate accidental discoveries).

words.sentence1: Te amaré por la eternidad (I will love you for eternity).
words.sentence2: Pareció una eternidad esperar la respuesta (It seemed like an eternity waiting for the answer).

words.sentence1: Un beau papillon s'est posé sur la fleur (A beautiful butterfly landed on the flower).
words.sentence2: J'ai des papillons dans le ventre (I have butterflies in my stomach / I am nervous).

words.sentence1: Sein Wanderslust brachte ihn in die entlegensten Winkel der Welt (His wanderlust took him to the most remote corners of the world).
words.sentence2: Im Frühling packt mich immer die Wanderslust (In spring, I am always overcome with wanderlust).

words.sentence1: Mori no naka de utsukushii komorebi o mita (I saw beautiful sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest).
words.sentence2: Komorebi ga kirei na shashin o totta (I took a picture where the sunlight filtering through the leaves was beautiful).

words.sentence1: Il Colosseo è una vera meraviglia del mondo (The Colosseum is a true marvel of the world).
words.sentence2: Guardavo il mare con meraviglia (I looked at the sea with wonder).

words.sentence1: Wo men zai zhe li xiang yu zhen shi you yuanfen (Meeting each other here is truly fate).
words.sentence2: You shi hou yuanfen hui rang liang ge ren zou zai yi qi (Sometimes fate brings two people together).

words.translation: Yearning / Longing for someone or something
words.sentence1: Gohyange 대한 geuriumi maeumeul apeuge handa (The yearning for my hometown makes my heart ache).
words.sentence2: Geuriumeun sigan i 지나도 줄어들지 않는다 (The longing does not diminish even as time passes).

words.sentence1: Knhom mean sneh champoh kromuon nih (I have affection for this family).
words.sentence2: Sneh chea krea phka knong chivit (Love is the foundation of life).

words.sentence1: Sy het 'n groot verlangen na haar ouers (She has a deep longing for her parents).
words.sentence2: Die verlangen na vrede is universeel (The longing for peace is universal).
